_why: Per-video, beside the fact ledger (H26). A global register answers for the wrong cut: this one was blocked for weeks by unresolved provenance on ep01's engravings, which s01 does not use and has never used.
_scope: An empty asset list is a POSITIVE declaration, not an unfinished file: every object on screen in s01 is generated by the harness from the dimensions cited in spec/s01/facts/s01.facts.json - a 140 mm bore and 100 mm rod from Bosch Rexroth RE 17331 - and no third-party image, model, texture, footage or music appears in the cut. Anything that changes this has to be listed here before it ships: a voice track that is not the harness's own scratch `say` pass, a music bed, a logo, a photograph, a purchased model.

assets.description: Human figure, the scale witness in c05. One object (GEO-body_male_realistic) extracted from the bundle into assets/figure_standing.blend.
assets.source: Blender Studio, Human Base Meshes bundle v1.4.1
assets.modifications: extracted one object of seventeen; removed the MULTIRES modifier and the .sculpt_mask / .sculpt_face_set attributes (47 MB -> 617 KB); scaled at build time so the figure measures its declared height exactly
assets.status: VERIFIED - CC0 is stated by Blender Studio for the asset-bundle programme and the bundle is served from download.blender.org. A dated screenshot of the licence page is still outstanding, per this file's own _why.
assets.note: The first third-party asset in this repo. Admissible under the one-line rule in docs/research/3d-asset-licensing-master-2026-09-17.md - CC0, public domain, CC BY - which is also why a Mixamo or Sketchfab-NC figure would not be.
